prose.text: The gates are: - the unit tests of the two library crates; - the blitz-tests targets the steps write, plus their companions: the replay, spans, masks, actions, cross-OS   readings and select interaction; - seven_guis' process checks; - the capability-statement pin; - the pre-push gate (`fast`); - the `doc` leg, because public doc comments change (`reached.rs`'s and `coverage.rs`'s module docs, the   `ReachedRecord` docs) and `fast` runs no rustdoc (`(test-plan · decision/doc-leg-gates-public-doc-edits)`); - `stand-repeat`.

No boot-path touchpoint changes a binary's start: `host_log`, `mcp_log`, `mcp_server` and `cli_commands` drive both roles and stand in for the smoke. There is no live leg, and the cold-agent pipe is not run. The a11y leg is not listed: this chunk changes no keyboard path of the engine. `--ctrl` sends a modifier the engine already reads, and `stand_act_select` runs in `stand-repeat`.

Each new check is controlled red-before-green (tests S3). After the steps are green, /implement makes five one-shot `gate.py control` runs, never entries: - **`ctrl` held as nothing.** In `execute.rs` `press`, drop the `ACTION_MODIFIER` join. Fired on the first blitz-tests   entry, case `a_press_with_ctrl_builds_a_set_of_rows_that_are_not_adjacent`. - **The graph never cut.** In `execute.rs` `graph`, answer `Outcome::Graphed` whole whatever the size. Fired on the   first blitz-tests entry, case `cells_reads_in_parts_each_within_the_budget_and_together_the_whole_graph`. - **The stop not read, unit.** In `reached.rs`, write every resolved entry whatever `propagates()` reads. Fired on the   unit entry, case `a_dispatch_its_target_stops_records_the_target_alone`. - **The stop not read, stand.** The same edit, fired on the first blitz-tests entry, case   `an_enter_the_cell_editor_stops_leaves_the_grids_keydown_unexercised`. - **The stop not read, binary.** The same edit, fired on the seven_guis entry, case   `an_enter_the_cell_editor_stops_leaves_the_grids_keydown_unexercised_through_the_coverage_role`.
Each control names the edit's text and the case by its test name, `--no-fail-fast` reaching it (gate-contract.md §Control).

The diff is OS-sensitive: `--ctrl` resolves through the `cfg(target_os = "macos")` `ACTION_MODIFIER` (execute.rs:797-802), ⌘ on macOS. So the operator's hygiene, push and CI entries stand, the CI read witnessing `stand_act_select`'s `--ctrl` test on the macOS aarch64 and windows x86_64 legs of `matrix_test`.
